symptom: mxcli exec of a script grows faster than its statement count on a larger project: seeding 300 entities, 600 microflows and 600 pages into PedApp took 45 s, 42 s and 286 s per stage where 120/240/240 took 10/10/46 s, and 1,600 pages had not finished after 15 minutes (ako/mxcli#2160)
cause: both the check before an exec (execPreflight -> validateProgramWithWarnings) and the exec itself list whole document types once per statement (buildFlowSignatures -> ListMicroflows from two validators per page statement; buildEntityIndex, checkMemberTypeIndex, checkAssociationCatalog, execCreateAssociation -> ListDomainModels; execCreatePageV3 -> ListPages), and every listing went through mprread.decodeUnits, which decoded each unit from its bytes on every call: about 1,000 full microflow listings for 600 page statements, at 0.11 s each
insight: Time one listing before blaming it: 616 microflows decode in 0.11 s, so 107 s under ListMicroflows in the profile is a call COUNT, and the fix is at the one function every listing shares rather than at the eight call sites the profile shows. The cache is keyed by a unit's stored bytes (kept and compared with bytes.Equal), so a write needs no invalidation. Two things make sharing a decoded element sound, and each has a test that fails without it: every lazily decoded scalar is loaded before the element is shared (42 data races under -race otherwise - the catalog builds with a worker pool), and an entry whose element IsDirty is decoded again instead of served (UpdateOqlQueriesForMovedEntity sets a property on a listed element). A unit is only remembered on its first decode and kept on its second, so a command that lists a type once pays nothing. Measured on the PedApp fixture: 240 decodes per added page statement before, 2 after; the 300/600/600 seed 45/42/286 s -> 25/22/110 s. What the second profile shows next is not decoding: every listing re-reads the unit files (readMprContents, a fifth of the page stage) because each write clears the reader's whole content cache, then gen -> sdk conversion and the GC that follows from both. MXCLI_CPUPROFILE=<file> profiles the real command; MXCLI_DECODE_CACHE=off rules the cache out.
